verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26875550 from Boise Semiconductor to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318620 (dated 2026-02-05). It confirms one line: 10,500 units of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD each, confirmed for 2026-03-09. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document has no handwriting or corrections. The delivery terms contradict each other.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: the document states EXW Boise (and says DDP is not agreed), but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally bears these costs, so the charges added to the invoice should be checked against the agreement.
The document gives no explicit order quantity to compare with the confirmed quantity. The confirmed quantity (10,500) should be checked against the PO.
The document has no issue date of its own.
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or visible damage.
The 'Qty' column is read as the confirmed quantity because the document is an order acknowledgement.
The separator in '10,500' is read as an English thousands comma, so the number is 10500.
